tasks.label: util: build static lib (Windows x64)
args: if not exist build-util mkdir build-util && "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && cl /nologo /EHsc /MT /Zi /utf-8 /c /D_STATIC /I "${workspaceFolder}" /I "${workspaceFolder}\data" /I "${workspaceFolder}\json" /I "${workspaceFolder}\kstring" /I "${workspaceFolder}\thread" /I "${workspaceFolder}\dtime" /I "${workspaceFolder}\parser" /I "${workspaceFolder}\interpretor" /I "${workspaceFolder}\flow" /I "${workspaceFolder}\dfile" @sources_util.rsp /Fobuild-util\ && cd build-util && lib /nologo /OUT:util.lib *.obj
